reason: The README describes a plugin that exposes an image_generate tool for calling compatible image-generation APIs and saving generated images in the workspace.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 Gemini 和 OpenAI Images 的接口生成图像，并将结果保存到当前工作区。
summaries.en: Generates images through Gemini-compatible and OpenAI Images-compatible APIs and saves the results in the current workspace.

capabilities: Generates images through Gemini-compatible and OpenAI Images-compatible APIs
Sends prompts and configured generation parameters to an external image service
Writes generated image files to workspace-confined output paths
Reads API credentials from plugin settings, environment variables, or an optional local runtime file
